name: commit_read
description: Read one commit in an Origin-hosted repository. Choose a single view: metadata, files, or a bounded patch. view defaults to metadata. A patch with no line range stops at 256 KiB and sets truncated. A line range returns at most 500 lines and also stops at 256 KiB. A line the cap cuts ends with …, and truncated is set. Lines before startLine are counted and dropped, so the result stays within that window. The scan takes longer when startLine is further into the patch.

owner.description: Origin namespace (owner) slug, taken from list_namespaces or an earlier Origin result. A GitHub owner or org name is not an Origin namespace unless list_namespaces returns it.

name.description: Origin repository name within that namespace

view.description: metadata (default), files, or a bounded patch
